attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"This is a familiar arrangement for Dunmore's Free Company.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a comparison with an earlier state the briefing does not give"},{"span":"Mercenary Kael Dunmore now has a price on his head following an ambush near Gallowmere.","severity":"minor","reason":"'now' implies a before/after change; also nearly duplicates the first sentence"},{"span":"It seems the Lantern Accord is keen on making a profit from a wanted man.","severity":"minor","reason":"a bounty is paid out, not profited from; it implies a motive, though it is hedged with 'It seems'"},{"span":"They are reportedly quiet behind their walls.","severity":"minor","reason":"'reportedly' is fine, but it is delivered as a stated fact and adds nothing"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":2,"comment":"The first item restates the same fact twice, and the later items are dull filler that give the facts with little real wit (the 'familiar arrangement' line implies a past state).
